name: Violent Shove OLD

stealth.note: (trained) to feel an ominous presence in the room

description: An invisible force bats creatures aside, hurling them into a nearby wall.
disable: DC 19 Occultism (trained) to disperse the force or DC 20 Religion (trained) to ward yourself from harm

generalAbilities.name: Shove
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature moves adjacent to the haunted wall

Effect A powerful force sweeps across the room, shoving all creatures in the room toward the wall. Each creature in the area must attempt a DC 20 Fortitude Saving Throw save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is pushed 5 feet toward the wall. If the creature would collide with the wall, they take (1d10+5) Bludgeoning Damage damage.

Failure The creature is pushed 10 feet toward the wall. If the creature would collide with the wall, they take (2d10+10) Bludgeoning Damage damage.

Critical Failure The creature is pushed 15 feet toward the wall. If the creature would collide with the wall, they take (3d10+15) Bludgeoning Damage damage and are knocked Prone.
